avis.texte: I loved the feeling of this product but it quickly went from a jelly stick to almost melting into more of a jello like consistency and eventually crumbled and flew out of the container when I was trying to take the cap off one day. It flung out in my car and got like goo chunks stuck everywhere and I couldn't put it back in the tube bc thats just unsanitary. I didn't even keep it anywhere hot where it could've melted. I received it for Christmas and it's been in my work bag the whole time. I live in the northeast so definitely no weather hot enough to melt it. Milk needs to figure out the formula because this product is NOT worth it at all with how quickly it breaks.

I was really excited to try this product which worked great the first few times. However, the jelly would crumble on my face at times. The jelly then fell out of the container and became completely useless.

I really wanted this to work. When I first got it, felt great, super cooling, I love the jelly texture. I even read the reviews to make sure I kept the little plastic cover on to keep it from falling apart like everyone elses did and it still fell apart after the second use. I'm sad, I love the idea. Maybe when they create a better formula, I'll try it again.
